changes.before: Build .199 current owner direction: the exact ten-rank ladder is Leader (Guild Master), High Council, Officer, Officer Alt, Raid Leader, Veteran, Raider, Member, Alt and Initiate. Display ranks are 1–10; zero-based native slots are 0–9. High Council is Rank 2 / Slot 1; Officer Rank 3 / Slot 2; Officer Alt Rank 4 / Slot 3. Co-Guild Master and Treasurer are appointments within the Leader / High Council tier, not additional native ranks. The [Olympus Role & Rank Rosetta Stone](#/roles/rosetta-stone) joins the current guide and all 102 stable offices / 138 assignable keys. Current ordinary choices are Member, Raider and Artisan; Leader, High Council and Officer Corps seats are reserved appointments. Six retained payload categories do not mean six open application tracks. Royal Writs and new Patron applications are paused while the separate Admin switch is OFF. Historical beta-five game observations and older ladder proposals are dated technical history, not competing current recommendations. This book records no executed game promotion; accepted Council seat, eligible vote, character rank and actual permission remain separate.

changes.before: The retained chart distinguishes PvP and Raiding portfolios; the current War Head guide centers organized PvE progression, with PvP an optional activity remit. Neither appointments nor warrants are changed. The Federal Treasurer carries the finance portfolio. The Ministers of Artisanry and Heraldry carry the crafting and community portfolios. Accepted High Councillors without another portfolio ordinarily serve the Council of Justice, subject to case designation and conflict review. The Ministry of Propaganda directs guild campaigns and truthful recruitment storytelling alongside Heraldry’s official publication standards. Systems and Addons is technical support outside the High Council. Specialist service heads may advise the Council without becoming voting Council members unless separately appointed.
changes.after: The retained chart distinguishes PvP and Raiding portfolios; the current War Head guide centers organized PvE progression, with PvP an optional activity remit. changes.before: (a) The Council is a working cabinet, not a competing ladder of native ranks. Twelve reserved portfolios serve beneath the Guild Master as chair: Hand of the Sovereign · Co-Guild Master; Lord High Treasurer · Minister of the Imperial Exchequer; Lord High Justiciar · Minister of Justice & The Privy Court; Lord High Marshal of PvE · Minister of Raid Campaigns; Lord High Marshal of PvP · Minister of Battlegrounds & Honor; Lord High Inquisitor · Minister of Internal Security; Lord High Chancellor · Minister of the Chancery & Imperial Census; Lord High Legate · Minister of the Grand Concordat; Lord High Artificer · Minister of Artisanry & The Guild Workshop; Lord High Factor · Minister of Trading & Markets; Lord High Herald · Minister of Propaganda; Lord High Seneschal · Minister of Court Protocol & Crown Estates. The Sovereign may establish a further distinct portfolio through an explicit instrument. Existing office keys, holder records and historical ballots retain their identities; the current style grants no appointment, eligible vote, platform permission or additional native rank. The Addon / Discord Architect remains an Officer Corps technical specialist outside the Council.
changes.after: (a) The Guild Master chairs the High Council. The Co-Guild Master serves alongside twelve numbered portfolios in the [current Cabinet register](/static/governance/council-portfolios228.md). Systems & Heraldry sets technical stewardship and heraldic standards. The Addon / Discord Architect remains an Officer Corps specialist; the Herald directs campaigns and the Seneschal directs court protocol. The Sovereign may establish a further distinct portfolio through an explicit instrument. Each office keeps its own key and accepted warrant. Existing holder records and ballots retain their original identities.
